# Exo Telemetry

Directory: `C:\Sovereign\AE-Hub\data\exo\`

## Purpose
Stores exoskeleton telemetry, operator biometrics, safety alerts, and exo status reports.

## Subdirectories
- `telemetry/` — Per-session exo telemetry JSON streams
- `biometrics/` — Operator biometric data (heart rate, SpO2, temperature)
- `safety/` — Safety alert logs and emergency stop records

## Generated by
- `modules/exo_controller.py`

## Retention
90 days per governance.json
